notes: Was uncertified while the marker was unwrapped, which kept the text readable but made the page read-only. Preserving the marker as a placeholder pair keeps both: the commented text stays visible and editable, and the marker round-trips exactly. Real pages from confluence.cybernet.az drove this — they wrap most prose in <span style="color: rgb(0,0,0);">, so whole-element preservation would have hidden the page and unwrapping would have made it read-only.
